title: Remix Practice
description: Practise the twelve ideas in this Remix course. Choose an answer, then read why it fits the example.

exercises.question: Which value turns off server rendering here?
exercises.explanation: A single-page app loads a browser shell and lets routes choose its content. React Router framework mode can build this with server rendering turned off.

exercises.question: Which helper names a default route?
exercises.explanation: A route config maps addresses to route modules. An index route is the default page for its parent address.

exercises.question: What does the default export provide?
exercises.explanation: A route module exports a component to show for its address. Start with a small page before adding any data work.

exercises.question: Which prop gives the link destination?
exercises.explanation: Link changes the route while keeping the useful meaning of a link. Its to prop gives the destination.

exercises.question: What does Outlet display?
exercises.explanation: A parent route can wrap child routes. Outlet is the place where the matched child appears.

exercises.question: What is captured by :slug?
exercises.explanation: A route parameter captures a value from an address. useParams reads the captured values as strings.

exercises.question: Where does clientLoader run?
options: Only inside a private database server
exercises.explanation: clientLoader prepares route data in the browser. It can read a local public JSON file and return the values a page needs.

exercises.question: Why show a fallback during loading?
options: To hide every possible error forever
To explain that the route is preparing its data
exercises.explanation: A HydrateFallback can show a simple message while route data needed during initial hydration is loading.

exercises.question: What does isActive describe?
options: Whether the link destination matches the active route
Whether the visitor has an account
exercises.explanation: NavLink knows whether its destination is the active route. You can use that state to show which page is selected.

exercises.question: Where is this filter choice stored?
options: Only inside a hidden server session
exercises.explanation: Search parameters let a page keep small filter choices in the URL. A copied address can then describe the same filter.

exercises.question: What should an error view give the reader?
options: A clear explanation and a way to continue
exercises.explanation: A route ErrorBoundary can show a useful message when loading or rendering fails. It keeps the failure from becoming a blank screen.

exercises.question: Why does a client route need a host fallback?
options: The browser cannot follow ordinary links
The host must provide the app shell before the router can run
exercises.explanation: A browser route app needs its static host to return the app shell for supported client-side addresses. Otherwise a direct visit can fail before React runs.
